# Sofa order

- On Saturday 5 September I ordered the Marlow two-seater sofa in grey from Brackley Mill Furniture. The order number is BM-20417. I paid a deposit of 180 pounds.
- The shop promised delivery by Friday 9 October. Nothing has arrived.
- I rang on Monday 19 October and again on Monday 2 November. Both times I was told it would be "with us next week", and nobody called back.
- I want a delivery date from them in writing by Friday 20 November. If I do not get one, I will cancel the order and ask for the 180 pounds back.
- The shop's email address is `orders@brackleymill.example`.
